tools.name: create_cpp_class
tools.description: Create a new C++ class with header and implementation files. Validates code safety before writing. WARNING: If the header contains UCLASS/USTRUCT macros, Live Coding cannot compile it — editor restart required. WARNING: Only write or modify C++ files if the user EXPLICITLY requests a C++ solution. Otherwise, default to using Blueprint or Python tools.

header_code.description: Full content of the .h file including #pragma once, includes, UCLASS macro

auto_compile.description: Trigger Live Coding after writing. Only works for .cpp-only changes.

tools.name: modify_cpp_file
tools.description: Modify an existing C++ source file. The entire file content must be provided. WARNING: Only write or modify C++ files if the user EXPLICITLY requests a C++ solution. Otherwise, default to using Blueprint or Python tools.

file_path.description: Absolute path to the .h or .cpp file

content.description: Full new content of the file

tools.name: trigger_compile
tools.description: Trigger Live Coding compilation. Only works for .cpp implementation changes, not structural header changes.

tools.name: regenerate_project_files
tools.description: Regenerate Visual Studio/Rider project files after adding new source files.

tools.name: macro_create_cpp_class
tools.description:
Macro Tool: Automatically generates the exact C++ boilerplate for a new Unreal Engine class, avoiding common syntax and include errors that break the UnrealHeaderTool (UHT).

Use this tool INSTEAD of create_cpp_class when creating a standard class. It dynamically determines the API export macro, the Public/Private split, and the required parent includes. After generation, you can use modify_cpp_file to add custom logic into the generated files.

module_name.description: The exact name of the target module (e.g., 'MyGame' or 'AntigravityActions')

parent_class_header.description: Optional: If the parent class is uncommon, specify its include path (e.g., 'GameFramework/Actor.h'). Common classes (AActor, UObject) are handled automatically.

tools.name: get_cpp_reflection_info
tools.description: Query Unreal Engine's reflection system (UClass) to extract structural details of a compiled C++ class and return them as a JSON payload.

class_name.description: The C++ class name to inspect (with or without 'A'/'U' prefix, e.g. 'Actor' or 'AActor')
